_note: Synthetic. The ticket types of the service desk of the fictional company Halden Industrial. 'route' says where a type goes: 'ladder' types are worked here, at the level the autonomy ladder gives them; 'hand over' types are never resolved here. 'actions' are the fixes the suite offers for a type; an agent can ask for no other. 'touches_identity' marks the types where the first question is who is asking.

password-reset.name: Password reset
actions: reset password and send a one-time sign-in link to the owner's registered contact

mfa-reset.name: Second-factor reset
actions: reset the second factor and enrol the owner's registered phone

recovery-contact-change.name: Change of recovery email or phone
actions: replace the recovery contact on the account

access-request.name: Access to a shared folder or application

software-install.name: Standard software installation
actions: install the package from the software catalogue

printer.name: Printer fault
actions: clear the print queue and restart the spooler

mailbox-full.name: Mailbox or disk full
actions: closed after 72 hours without a reply

security-report.name: Suspicious email, sign-in or account change
